rest.title: Rest

optIn.title: Rest estimate
optIn.switch: Show an estimate of my rest
optIn.body: An estimate made from the baby's log, shown only to you. It is not a measurement.

status.notEnoughLog: Not enough in the log to estimate this night.
status.disabled: The rest estimate is turned off.

rest.disclaimer: Estimated from the baby's log, not a measurement.
rest.error: The estimate could not be loaded.

offline.last: Shown from your last connection. Connect to refresh it.

morning.title: Are you up for the day?

work.title: Work hours
work.hint: Working hours are never counted as rest. A window that ends before it starts runs overnight.

fallAsleep.label: Minutes to fall asleep
fallAsleep.help: How long after the baby goes to bed you usually fall asleep.

wakeLead.label: Minutes awake before you log
wakeLead.help: How long before an entry you logged you are assumed to have been up.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.help: For example America/Sao_Paulo. Your work hours and night follow it.

errors.timeZone: Enter a valid time zone, for example America/Sao_Paulo.
errors.windowDays: Each work window needs at least one day.
errors.windowTimes: Fill in the start and end of every work window.
errors.windowSame: A work window cannot start and end at the same time.
errors.nightTimes: Fill in when the night starts and ends.
errors.nightSame: The night cannot start and end at the same time.

turnOff.action: Turn off and delete my rest settings
turnOff.title: Turn off the rest estimate?
turnOff.body: Your work hours, night, time zone and morning answers are deleted from the server. You can turn it on again later.

history.title: History
history.intro: Your own past nights, estimated again from the baby's log each time you open this.
history.error: The history could not be loaded.
history.empty: No night in this period has an estimate yet.

chart.title: Night by night
chart.label: Estimated rest, night by night, newest first
chart.gaps: Gaps are times you are estimated to be up.
chart.workOverlap: Overlaps your work hours, not in the typical values
chart.caption: Estimated rest per night

typical.title: Typical rested time
typical.hint: Weeknights start Monday to Friday; weekend nights Saturday and Sunday. The bar spans the middle half of your counted nights; the mark is the middle night.
typical.label: Typical rested time on weeknights and weekend nights
typical.caption: Typical rested time

typicalNight.title: A typical night
typicalNight.label: How often you are estimated to be asleep at each hour
typicalNight.hint: The stronger an hour's colour, the more of your counted nights you are estimated to be asleep in it.
typicalNight.caption: Share of counted nights estimated asleep, by hour
